# Harshith Nayaka L — AI Engineer, Full-Stack

> Full-stack AI Engineer based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India, building AI agents, RAG pipelines, LLM applications, and the production backends and interfaces around them. Currently AI Workflow Engineer at DemandNXT. Available for select freelance projects.

Harshith Nayaka L specialises in the unglamorous part of applied AI — making systems behave the same way on the hundredth run as on the first. Core areas: AI agents and orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM integration, multi-modal pipelines (voice, vision, text), output reliability via schema-constrained generation, full-stack AI applications, backend engineering (FastAPI, Node, Postgres), local and cloud inference (Google Cloud AI, Hugging Face, Ollama), and workflow automation with n8n. Building with code since 2022; reached the semi-finals of the Gen AI Exchange Hackathon 2025 (a national event with 270,000+ developers, organised by Google Cloud).

Every link below points at markdown. Each page on this site also serves a clean markdown version at its own URL with `index.md` appended, and declares it with `rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"`; the HTML page at the same address is the human version. Read `/llms-full.txt` instead if you would rather have every case study in a single fetch.

## When to use this

Reach for this site when a question is about Harshith Nayaka L specifically, or when you need a worked example of one of the following built by a named engineer with the source public.

Good fits: multi-model LLM orchestration and verifier design; routing requests across model tiers by difficulty and cost; multi-agent architecture where agents must not share context; retrieval pipelines grounded in real data; running an LLM locally with no cloud fallback; schema-constrained generation and output validation; keeping provider credentials server-side in a serverless proxy; free-tier rate-limit handling (RPM and TPM token buckets, provider fallback chains).

Poor fits: this is one engineer's portfolio, not a product, a company or an API. There is no public API, no SDK, no developer portal and nothing to call programmatically. If a task needs a service endpoint, this is the wrong source.

How to use it: read /llms-full.txt for every case study in one fetch, or follow a case-study link below and request its markdown twin. For structured records rather than prose, GET /api/v1/case-studies - the same content as JSON, described by /openapi.json. Any page route also answers `Accept: text/markdown` and `?mode=agent`. To reach him, email harshith28124@gmail.com.

## Case studies

- [Creative-Ops Pipeline](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/creative-ops-pipeline/index.md): Flagship. A multi-model content pipeline that turns a one-line brief into validated, on-brand output using tiered model routing, schema-constrained generation, QA gates, and failure recovery.
- [CraftConnect](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/craftconnect/index.md): Gen AI Exchange Hackathon 2025 semi-finalist. A multi-modal assistant letting artisans run an online storefront by talking and showing instead of typing, built on Gemini and Google Cloud.
- [Maestro](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/maestro/index.md): A live, open-source multi-model orchestration engine. A conductor routes one task across thinker/worker/verifier roles over free LLMs and returns a single verified answer with a full, replayable decision-log. Live at https://maestro-psi-neon.vercel.app/
- [Cannon](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/cannon/index.md): A daily-driver multi-agent personal assistant — each domain (fitness, work) is an independent specialist with its own persona, tools, and retrieval scope, isolation enforced at the query rather than by convention. Typed provider fallback (Groq→Gemini) makes the whole stack degrade gracefully, including in CI. Live at https://cannon-multi-agents.vercel.app
- [ReplyDesk](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/replydesk/index.md): A WhatsApp lead agent that answers every inbound message in ~8 seconds, with a live operations dashboard for the lead feed, pipeline, and response-time KPIs.
- [Nova](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/nova-ai/index.md): A chat app that routes by difficulty rather than by model picker. Every turn is scored on four axes, an arbiter model confirms or overrides the lane, and the turn goes to the smallest of three models that can carry it — with the lane, the reasoning and the cost stamped on the answer. Live at https://custom-gpt-silk.vercel.app/
- [BlogSpace](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/blogspace/index.md): A full-stack blogging platform with JWT auth, role-based access, and an admin panel (React, Node, MongoDB).
- [AI Notes](https://harshith-nayaka-l-portfolio.vercel.app/work/ai-notes/index.md): A notes app running DeepSeek R1 locally through Ollama, so inference never leaves the machine.

## Published research

- [AI-Powered Note-Taking System: A Local Machine Learning Approach DeepSeek R1 Integration](https://www.doi.org/10.59256/ijrtmr.20250506023): Peer-reviewed paper authored by Harshith Nayaka L, published in the International Journal of Research Trends and Multidisciplinary Research (IJRTMR), Nov-Dec 2025, pp. 178-189. DOI: 10.59256/ijrtmr.20250506023. Documents the local-inference architecture behind the AI Notes project: running a model on-device for summarization, writing improvement, idea expansion, and keyword extraction, reporting 87% user satisfaction on summarization with 1.9-3.8 second response times.
